codeReview.summary: The feature migrates the 9 scoped CLI files to TypeScript with explicit typings and preserved module/export patterns. Feature scope and expected behavior are covered, and validation evidence in transcript/handoff shows clean typecheck, unit tests, and lint. One edge-case behavior drift was identified in recursive file lookup error handling, but it is non-blocking.

issues.description: Recursive traversal now guards the recursive call result and silently skips `undefined` results (`lookupFiles(pathname, extensions, recursive)`), whereas prior JS behavior spread the recursive result directly. In edge cases where a nested stat/read race causes the recursive call to return `undefined`, behavior changes from surfacing an error to silently omitting files.
